name: FINEOS Corporation Holdings plc
summary: FINEOS Corporation Holdings plc, together with its subsidiaries, engages in the development and sale of enterprise claims and policy management software for life, accident and health insurers, and employee benefits providers in North America, the Asia Pacific, Europe, the Middle East, and Africa.
